protocol_id_rule: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON scientific_spec with sorted keys and compact separators

scientific_spec.scope: single-model single-corpus matched multi-seed Pythia-70M LoRA study
scientific_spec.study_question: Does model-top-k history unlikelihood reduce held-out greedy-generation loops relative to a strength-zero matched baseline without material held-out causal-LM loss regression?

implementation.required_source_state: objective execution must use this exact commit; the protocol and prompt-set commit may be a clean descendant containing only evidence specification files

training.no_retuning_rule: Do not change strength, proposal_top_k, context_window, candidate cap, seeds, prompt set, horizon, or acceptance thresholds after any study run begins.

generation_endpoint.prompt_provenance: fresh independent prompts fixed before training and not selected from prior or current model outputs

decoding.seed: same seed as the training run

metrics.primary_effect: model_topk_history_minus_baseline paired by seed, lower is better
metrics.primary_aggregate: arithmetic mean of the three paired seed effects

acceptance.generation_evidence_validation: every report must round-trip through validate_zspace_generation_evidence in the Rust semantic core
identity_requirements: verified model runtime, execution, corpus materialization, tokenized dataset, training recipe, and finetune replay identities
one prompt_set_id across all six generation reports
one decoding_config_id per seed shared by both arms
content-addressed adapter identity for every generation report
stability_requirements: no non-finite before-train or after-train evaluation loss
no failed or partial optimizer trajectory receipt
no failed, empty, or malformed generation row
no early termination before 64 optimizer updates
objective receipts ready for all three model_topk_history runs
acceptance.decision_rule: Pass only if all readiness and stability requirements, both primary success conditions, and both safety thresholds hold. Otherwise record the study as ready-but-negative or blocked without retuning this study.

interpretation.allowed_positive_claim: Within this prespecified bounded Pythia-70M/Dubliners pilot, the model-top-k history objective reduced the selected loop metric with the required seed direction and without material held-out CE regression.
interpretation.allowed_negative_claim: This frozen objective recipe did not satisfy the prespecified bounded pilot gate.
interpretation.promotion_if_passed: run a separately prespecified multi-model and multi-corpus study with semantic-quality evaluation
